Manifest.Name: 垃圾场拓展 / Scrapyard Expansion
Manifest.Author: Cycbloom
Manifest.Description: 八区域垃圾场、分区物资与场景、声望成长、每周区域事件和独立大小奖。0/20/40/60声望逐批开放地点，80开放贵重品，100开放补给箱与钥匙卡及次日同行服务。含拾荒客开局与可调掉落设置。 / Eight scavenging areas with distinct loot and artwork, reputation progression, weekly regional events and adaptive rewards. Areas unlock at 0/20/40/60 reputation, valuables at 80, crates/keycards and outing service at 100. Includes a Scavenger start and configurable loot.
